As expected, we observed a consistent tradeoff between bio-conservation and batch effect removal. While BBKNN and Seurat v3 tended to remove batch variation, scANVI and scGen prioritized bio-conservation. Learning a more regularized implicit latent space of each batch mediated stronger batch removal while also removing biological variation.
